explainer_content.short_definition: Writer-forward 1960s and 1970s songcraft where the singer's point of view is the main instrument.
explainer_content.history_capsule: This road grows out of folk revival authorship, Brill Building craft, and album-era adult pop. It turns the songwriter from a hidden professional into the face and voice of the record.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It made personal lyric writing a mainstream popular-music language and gave later adult pop, indie folk, and Americana a durable model.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The songs ask to be heard as statements from a person, not just performances by a band.

canonical_example_rationales.why_this_example_matters: Carole King anchors Classic singer-songwriter by making story-first lyrics and twang or pedal-steel color easier to hear.
James Taylor anchors Classic singer-songwriter by making twang or pedal-steel color and dance or ballad pacing easier to hear.
Blue - Joni Mitchell anchors Classic singer-songwriter by making dance or ballad pacing and plainspoken vocal stance easier to hear.
Tapestry - Carole King anchors Classic singer-songwriter by making plainspoken vocal stance and radio polish against roots texture easier to hear.
Fire and Rain - James Taylor anchors Classic singer-songwriter by making radio polish against roots texture and story-first lyrics easier to hear.
American Pie - Don McLean anchors Classic singer-songwriter by making story-first lyrics and twang or pedal-steel color easier to hear.
